Job Description: 
 
 
 The Network Infrastructure Management Platforms Engineer Lead is responsible for establishing and leading the Enterprise Network Controller Platform Program supporting Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Nexus Dashboard Live Protect, and Cisco Crosswork Network Controller.

 This role serves as the technical leader, educator, and platform steward responsible for ensuring Enterprise Network teams fully leverage controller capabilities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen security posture, accelerate software lifecycle management, and increase automation adoption.

 The position translates Bank Global Information Security (GIS) policy into practical network platform controls and develops a sustainable training and enablement program that drives consistent usage across End User Networks, Data Center Networking, Core Transport, and Device Authentication & Authorization.
 
 
 
 
 Shift: 
1st shift (United States of America) 
 
 Hours Per Week:  
40

This role is eligible to participate in the annual discretionary plan. Employees are eligible for an annual discretionary award based on their overall individual performance results and behaviors, the performance and contributions of their line of business and/or group; and the overall success of the Company. 
 
Benefits 
 
This role is currently benefits eligible. We provide industry-leading benefits, access to paid time off, resources and support to our employees so they can make a genuine impact and contribute to the sustainable growth of our business and the communities we serve.
